member.summary:
Hosted background service that periodically adjusts credit windows for streams operating in .
On each tick the controller inspects every active stream's utilisation ratio and applies one of three strategies:
Widen
When utilisation falls below and no backpressure is currently active, a of extra credits is released to allow short producer bursts without throttling.
Hold
When utilisation exceeds the controller withholds proactive credit release and lets the existing handle throttling naturally.
Neutral
Utilisation between the two thresholds — no intervention.
When is not the service exits immediately without consuming resources.
